english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for ordinary purchases, what money can buy in a given context, and purchases made for a group or organization.
This is the all-purpose everyday verb for buying or obtaining something by paying for it.

examples.english: I want to buy a new book.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bun2 san1 syu1

examples.english: I want to purchase a new mobile phone.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1
